from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class OperatingRevenueRecord(BaseModel):
    """Captures the operating revenue data for a single company in a specific reporting period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reporting the revenue")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The specific reporting period (e.g., '2025年第1季度', 'Q1 2025')")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="The operating revenue amount as a numeric value")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the revenue (e.g., 'CNY', '元')")
    source_document_id: Optional[int] = Field(description="The identifier of the document this record was extracted from")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted operating revenue records from the document collection."""
    revenue_records: List[OperatingRevenueRecord]
